content: Since many entity names of great importance are rare words from the input, we use the copying mechanism BIBREF20 that learns when to replicate words from the input or to predict words from the target vocabulary. The probability distribution of generating the word $y$ is calculated as follows, in which the $softmax$ function is calculated over a combined logits from both sides.
